title: The Little Raid: a new stall
lines: In The Little Raid, the stall has a new layout. Your level, Reroll and Buy XP are on the left. Your acorns sit above the cards. Hold and Set out are on the right.
Each card lists its figure's traits by name, with the cost on a tab above the name. The cards have cleaner edges. While you drag a figure, the sell price covers only the cards.
